events.title: Budget Measures Implementation Act, 2002 assented: section 8 repeals the Forest Renewal Act, and section 28 dissolves Forest Renewal BC on that repeal

evidence.locator: SBC 2002 c. 7, assent heading, PDF p. 1; ss. 8, 28, 32

events.interpretation_notes: Assent. The repeal and dissolution waited on regulation (s. 32).

events.title: OIC 517/2002 brings sections 7-11 and 28 of the Budget Measures Implementation Act, 2002 into force

evidence.locator: Original OIC 517/2002, stamped approval date; operative paragraphs (a) and (c)

events.interpretation_notes: The order's approval; its regulation took effect on deposit the next day.

events.title: Forest Renewal BC dissolved, with the repeal of the Forest Renewal Act, when B.C. Reg. 158/2002 was deposited

evidence.locator: BC Gazette Part II, vol. 45 no. 12 (2 July 2002), Regulation 158/2002 opening paragraph; Regulations Act s. 4(1)

events.interpretation_notes: The statutory dissolution: its rights, property and assets vested in the government (s. 28). The Gazette was published on 2 July 2002.

events.title: The SSO Administration Society (BC Health Authority Shared Services Organization) begins operating

evidence.locator: SSO Administration Society 2010/11 audited statements, note 1, PDF p. 7

events.interpretation_notes: Its operating start, apart from its 15 October 2008 incorporation.

events.title: The SSO Administration Society's net assets transferred to PHSA's Health Shared Services BC division

evidence.locator: SSO Administration Society 2010/11 audited statements, note 1, PDF p. 7

events.interpretation_notes: The executed transfer; the members' and PHSA's approvals (30 March and 12 April 2010) were separate steps. The society later became BC Clinical and Support Services Society.

operationalEnd.locator: OIC 1093/1985, bringing the British Columbia Transit Amendment Act (No. 2), 1985 into force on 1 June 1985

attestations.scope: a new board appointed from that day
its constituting Act in the 1991 consolidation, administered by Human Resources
attestations.locator: Metro Transit Operating Company Act, 1991 consolidation, administration heading

set.description: Crown corporation established on 18 January 1980 under the Metro Transit Operating Company Act to operate Vancouver-area transit, with a Cabinet-appointed board. On 1 June 1985 its property, obligations and employees passed to British Columbia Transit, and a new board was appointed the same day; when the company ended in law is untraced.

body_changes.why: Integration review §5: 1 June 1985 is an operational transfer, not a legal end (OIC 1096/1985 appoints a board that day). The legal end is untraced; drawn as a shell to its last sighting.
